result_text:
I fixed the NullPointerException when a sub-landscape has no readable `config.json`. I only compiled the `reports` module (it compiles cleanly). I didn't run any tests or generate a report with a missing config, so the fix itself hasn't been exercised.

The change is in `reports/.../landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportSubLandscapesSection.java`, in `addSubLandscapeRow`. A config that is missing or unreadable now gives a null metadata, which falls through to the default landscape logo. The row still links to the sub-landscape's index page, and sub-landscapes with a config keep their own logo. I made no other changes.

I also noticed a second, unrelated bug in the same file: `addSubLandscapeCountCells` has a duplicated `landscapeReport.endTableCell()` call. I left it alone as out of scope.
